text: Daicel Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (code 4202). Its largest shareholders (as of 2026-03-31) were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account, 13.81%), Custody Bank of Japan (trust account, 10.36%) and Nippon Life Insurance (6.81%); no state or sovereign shareholder appears in the company's top-10 list.
short: Daicel is TSE-listed (4202); top holders are trust banks and insurers, no state shareholder.
